verdict.rationale: doola's Partner API docs describe a dedicated sandbox: sandbox keys never trigger real state filings or charges, and sandbox-only endpoints advance formation and EIN milestones on demand while firing real webhooks. That lets a user exercise the whole integration in isolation, not just as a dry run. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox, and an explicit statement that sandbox data is kept separate from production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Always build and test against sandbox first. Sandbox keys never trigger real state filings or charges.
Two sandbox-only endpoints complete the formation and EIN milestones on demand, firing the real webhooks, so you can exercise your whole integration
